map.计算前倾角(Pantoscopic Tilt)对光学中心位置的影响与调整量: Compute the effect of the pantoscopic tilt on the optical center position and the adjustment amount
map.📖 查看「镜架前倾角调整器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Frame Pantoscopic Tilt Adjuster User Guide"
map.镜架前倾角补偿：每 1° 前倾角需下移光学中心约 0.5mm，调整后瞳高 = 原: Frame pantoscopic tilt compensation: each 1° of tilt requires lowering the optical center by about 0.5 mm; the adjusted pupillary height = original pupillary height + tilt × 0.5; the decentration prism effect P(Δ) = c(cm) × D is estimated by Prentice's rule.
map.前倾角每增加1°，光学中心需下移约0.5mm以保持视轴通过镜片光心，避免产生棱镜: For each 1° increase in tilt, the optical center must be lowered by about 0.5 mm to keep the visual axis through the lens optical center, avoiding prism effects and aberrations.
map.镜片前面与垂直面的夹角，正常范围5°-9°。前倾角使镜片更贴合面部曲线，扩大下方: The angle between the lens front surface and the vertical plane, normally 5°-9°. The tilt makes the lens conform better to the facial contour and expands the lower field of view.
map.左右镜圈所在平面的夹角，正常范围170°-180°。过大或过小会导致瞳距偏差。: The angle between the planes of the left and right rims, normally 170°-180°. Too large or too small causes pupillary distance deviation.
map.镜片后表面到角膜顶点的距离，标准12-14mm。影响有效镜度，高屈光度需注意补偿: The distance from the lens back surface to the corneal vertex, standard 12-14 mm. It affects the effective power, and high powers need attention for compensation.
map.前倾角调整需结合佩戴者面部特征和镜片类型综合考量，高散光和渐进片对前倾角更敏感。: Tilt adjustment requires considering the wearer's facial features and lens type; high astigmatism and progressive lenses are more sensitive to tilt.
map.按前倾角算光心下移量保视轴对齐。: Compute the optical center lowering by tilt to keep the visual axis aligned.
map.渐进片对倾斜角更敏感。: Progressive lenses are more sensitive to tilt.
map.前倾角 8° → 光心下移量=8×0.5=4mm；若不做相应下移，视线偏高产生棱: Tilt 8° → optical center lowering = 8×0.5=4 mm; without the corresponding lowering, the line of sight is too high, producing prism and aberration.
map.前倾角 <5° 视野偏上、>9° 像差增大且镜片外凸，5–9° 兼顾下方阅读与美: A tilt <5° shifts the field upward, and >9° increases aberration and protrudes the lens; 5-9° balances lower reading and aesthetics.
map.让镜片更垂直视轴、优化下方阅读区（尤其渐进），并改善美观贴合。: Makes the lens more perpendicular to the visual axis, optimizes the lower reading area (especially for progressives) and improves aesthetics and fit.
map.镜面与面部垂线夹角，配镜仪或量角器测，配渐进须精确并据此移光心。: The angle between the lens plane and the facial vertical; measure with a fitting instrument or protractor; for progressive fitting it must be precise and the optical center shifted accordingly.
map.计算镜架前倾角对光学中心位置的影响，确定光心下移量，确保视轴通过镜片光学中心。: Compute the effect of the frame pantoscopic tilt on the optical center position, determine the optical center lowering and ensure the visual axis passes through the lens optical center.
map.镜架前倾角调整器，计算前倾角对光学中心位置的影响，每度倾斜需下移光心0.5mm。: Frame Pantoscopic Tilt Adjuster; compute the effect of tilt on the optical center position, with each degree of tilt requiring a 0.5 mm optical center lowering. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
